tier_definitions.GREEN: Normal operation. Telemetry within standard tolerance.
tier_definitions.YELLOW: Potential drift or minor performance degradation. Continue inference, increase monitoring.
tier_definitions.ORANGE: Material degradation (e.g. MAE +25%, Bias > 15 µg/m³). Requires investigation; do not auto-retrain.
tier_definitions.RED: Critical operational failure (e.g. Contract violation, MAE +50%, NaN/Inf output). Trigger deterministic rollback.
